title: 第201章 谁允许你们杀人的第200章 让我看看你们是怎么舍命一搏的
slug: 人在镇魔司红词加身只杀不渡
lines: 周元青与曹衍相继重伤，孟守静僵在原地，脸色白得像纸。
这一刻，他已经顾不上其它了，转身就跑。
灵力催到极致，脚下山石被蹬得炸裂，整个人化作一道残影往山道下方冲去。
他自幼在玄清观长大，论修为或许不如周元青，论符法或许不如曹衍。
但跑路……
刚冲出丈余，乔山横跨两步，从树丛后斜插而出。
呛啷！
横刀出鞘，封死了下山必经之路。
“让开！”
孟守静暴喝一声，手中符纸化作青光朝乔山激射而去。
如今已是山穷水尽，他拼死也要搏一条出路。
乔山可是三十年的镇魔校尉，跟妖魔打了半辈子交道，什么搏命的招式没见过？
只见他不闪不避，反手抽出腰间横刀，灵力涌入刀刃，一道将那青光劈散。
随即他踏前一步，横刀翻转，刀柄狠狠砸在孟守静胸口。
孟守静闷哼一声，整个人被这一击砸得倒在地上。
他挣扎着撑起身子，看着那方正面孔越来越近，心头那根紧绷的弦终于断了。
他不想跟曹长老一样被打成重伤，更不想跟冯长老一样被押回收监。
他是观主嫡孙，从小在玄清观被捧在手心里长大，何曾受过这等生死之间的煎熬？
“这位大人！”
孟守静声音发抖，“玄清观观主孟怀玄是我爷爷——”
陆渊连眼皮都没抬，他最不耐烦的就是这种打不过就搬背景的戏码。
上一个在他面前自报家门的是冯端，这次又是孟守静。
怎么每个踢到铁板的都觉得玄清观的名头能当护身符？
陆渊头也不回道：
“让他闭嘴。”
乔山眼中闪过一抹冷厉，陆渊的行事风格他早有耳闻。
血衣阎君都发话了，还能留你？
手起刀落。
嚓！
鲜血喷溅，孟守静瞪大的眼睛还没来得及闭上，便已没了声息。
陆渊扭头看去，愣了一瞬，“你……”
content_en:
Zhou Yuanqing and Cao Yan were seriously injured one after another, while Meng Shoujing froze on the spot, her face as white as paper.
At this moment, he couldn't care about anything else, turned around and ran away.
The spiritual power was pushed to the extreme, and the rocks under his feet were kicked to pieces, and the whole person turned into an afterimage and rushed down the mountain road.
He grew up in Xuanqing Temple since he was a child. In terms of cultivation, he may not be as good as Zhou Yuanqing, and in terms of talismans, he may not be as good as Cao Yan.
But running away...
Just after rushing out for more than ten feet, Qiao Shan took two steps across and stepped out from behind the bushes.
Choking!
The horizontal sword was unsheathed, blocking the only way down the mountain.
"Get out of the way!"
Meng Shoujing shouted violently, and the talisman in her hand turned into green light and shot towards Qiao Shan.
Now that he is at the end of his rope, he is desperate to find a way out.
Qiao Shan has been a demon-suppressing captain for thirty years. He has been dealing with demons for half his life. What kind of life-threatening moves have he not seen before?
I saw that he did not dodge or evade, and drew out the horizontal knife from his waist with his backhand, and spiritual power poured into the blade, splitting the green light in one stroke.
Then he took a step forward, flipped the knife horizontally, and hit Meng Shoujing's chest hard with the handle.
Meng Shoujing groaned and fell to the ground due to the blow.
He struggled to hold himself up, watching the square face getting closer and closer, and the tight string in his heart finally broke.
He didn't want to be seriously injured like Elder Cao, let alone be taken back to prison like Elder Feng.
He is the direct grandson of the temple master. He grew up in Xuanqing Temple and was held in the palm of his hand. How has he ever suffered such torture between life and death?
"This lord!"
Meng Shoujing's voice trembled, "Meng Huaixuan, the master of Xuanqing Temple, is my grandfather——"
Lu Yuan didn't even raise his eyelids. What he was most impatient with was this kind of drama that just used the background if he couldn't win.
The last person to announce his family name in front of him was Feng Duan, and this time it was Meng Shojing.
Why does everyone think that Xuan Qingguan's name can be used as a talisman?
Lu Yuan said without turning around:
"Shut him up."
A cold look flashed in Qiao Shan's eyes. He had already heard of Lu Yuan's acting style.
Blood-clothed Yan Jun has already spoken, can he still keep you?
The knife fell from the hand.
Crack!
Blood splattered, and before Meng Shoujing's widened eyes could close, there was no sound.
Lu Yuan turned to look and was stunned for a moment, "You..."
title_en: Chapter 201 Who allowed you to kill people? Chapter 200 Let me see how you risked your lives.
